meta.name: ernie-image
meta.description: Build Baidu ERNIE-Image / ERNIE-Image-Turbo workflows — primarily TEXT-TO-IMAGE. Pick ERNIE when you need precise multilingual text rendering, posters/signage, manga/anime multi-panel layouts, or strong instruction following for complex multi-object scenes. Also supports denoise-based image-to-image refine (NOT instruction-grounded editing — use Qwen-Image-Edit or Flux Kontext for "change X in this photo" edits).
